description: Rabbi Chaim Vital’s kabbalistic interpretations of prayers, based on the teachings of R. Isaac Luria and edited by Vital’s son, Rabbi Samuel Vital Complete Kabbalah text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Kabbalah is the Jewish mystical and theosophical tradition. Its works range from short speculative treatises to the multi-volume Zohar, and its language is symbolic rather than propositional.
